name: Bakonysárkány (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of red and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Bakonysárkány (a red and green shield with a white dragon and a patriarchal cross, within a green wreath) above a yellow scroll inscribed BAKONYSÁRKÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bakonysárkány arms with wreath and scroll
